We're looking for a software engineer who understands the user's problem, architects a solution, and ships it. Sometimes the same day. Your work lives in production, not in a design doc.

You'll use AI workflows to move faster alongside the team and customers, bringing the best solutions to life. We think really big and ship fast, without lowering the bar on quality. You'll define how engineering operates here by figuring out what's actually possible when a great engineer leans all the way into AI.

Your architecture and your code will be how this company scales. When you build something that works, we move. Engineers at Range are catalysts, turning ideas into real products and creating momentum. That's how we lead. Ship fast, learn, iterate.

A builder. You go from problem to prototype to production. You don't wait for a perfectly scoped ticket or a sprint planning meeting. You see the gap and you close it.

Craft-obsessed. You've studied how the best companies build software and have real opinions about what makes it great. Your standards are high. What you ship is clean, secure, and considered, even when you ship it fast.

Intuition-driven. You've done enough reps to trust your gut on architecture decisions, move quickly, and be right far more often than you're wrong. When the requirements aren't clear, you use judgement to evaluate tradeoffs. Always finding a way to move.

AI-native. You're already using AI every day as core infrastructure. You see it as the thing that turns one engineer into ten.

Full-stack by instinct. Frontend, backend, infrastructure. You go wherever the problem is. React, TypeScript, Node, AWS are your tools, not your identity. You pick up whatever's needed.

You care about outcomes. Every endpoint, every interaction, every system is built around how your customers will actually experience the product.




WHERE YOU’LL GROW AT THIS LEVEL

You operate independently, delivering consistent, high-quality results that align with team and company goals. You’ve built a reputation for good judgment — weighing trade-offs and outcomes thoughtfully before deciding.  - You're offended by the idea that AI changes everything about this job

 - You'd rather debate architecture than ship and iterate

 - You optimize for consensus over conviction

 - You think "move fast" means lower the bar




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or other programming languages

 - Experience building and operating production services on AWS or similar cloud platforms (EC2, ECS, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch)

 - Comfortable working across the stack — frontend, backend, infrastructure

 - Track record of owning features end-to-end, from design through deployment and monitoring

WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - Experience building complex web applications with React and TypeScript

* Lean into AI and agents, from automating development workflows to fleet analysis, triage, troubleshooting, and more.

* Experience building and shipping embedded systems in robotics, automotive, drones, or other high\-performance embedded contexts
* Strong programming skills in a systems language such as C\+\+ or Rust, plus fluency in Python for scripting and analysis
* Solid foundation building software on Linux\-based systems, with the versatility to work up and down the stack, from services and applications to performance tuning and system internals
* Comfortable developing, automating, and debugging across the hardware/software boundary
* Track record of leading projects, driving design decisions, and working effectively across hardware, autonomy, and platform teams


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Hands\-on work with real\-world sensing systems, including cameras, lidar, GPS/GNSS, IMUs, radar, or other fielded sensors
* Background in OTA, security, connectivity, telemetry, diagnostics, or other production\-hardening areas for connected fleets

Engagement Overview
Inflect is engaging an independent Backend Engineer Consultant in Brazil through Rippling (acting as a Contractor of Record) to build, deliver, and maintain provider adapters and gateway backend services that onboard new supply providers into the marketplace. This is an autonomous, high-impact consulting engagement focused on API integration architecture, Go backend service delivery, and supporting the migration from bespoke adapters toward self-serve provider onboarding workflows.
Working as an external subject matter expert, you will provide technical execution across the Integrations & Gateway surface, ensuring our marketplace supply ingestion, pricing engines, and adapter services run with high availability, observability, and automated resiliency.
Who We Are
We are a US-based advisory and marketplace that is revolutionizing the way companies buy and sell digital infrastructure (Datacenter, cloud, and network services). Digital infrastructure services are the building blocks of the internet and at the core of every industry. Traditionally it’s been bought manually through service provider sales people, resulting in high costs, slow procurement cycles, and services that aren’t the best fit - slowing down the ability of companies to build and innovate.
Inflect’s marketplace and advisory are removing friction so any company can get what they need, when they need it, with the right deal terms. By achieving our mission, we unlock businesses to build and human innovation to inflect!
Specialized Technical Capabilities Required
Backend & API Integration Mastery: 3–5 years of professional backend development with production expertise in Go (or strong adjacent languages with a rapid ramp to Go), REST/API integrations, Postgres, Redis, and cloud infrastructure on AWS.
Adapter & Tooling Engineering: Practical experience building provider adapters, schema mapping tools, validation guardrails, and message-queue/event-driven architectures.
Modern Integration Stack (Node/TS & LLMs): Exposure to Node.js/TypeScript backend tooling, LLM/agent integration frameworks, and GUI tooling to support self-serve adapter automation.
Cross-Border Async Collaboration: Fluent professional English communication skills for effective cross-border async collaboration, code reviews, and daily alignment across Brazil, Poland, and US time zones.
Scope of Services & Project Deliverables
Gateway & Adapter Service Delivery: Architect, build, and maintain Go-based backend services and provider adapters for network, bare-metal/GPU, and data providers (live pricing and availability).
Self-Serve Onboarding Frameworks: Contribute to schema mapping frameworks, GUI tooling, validation guardrails, and LLM-assisted integration frameworks that allow non-engineers to onboard providers with minimal overhead.
Adapter Maintenance & Observability: Own assigned adapter surfaces end-to-end under pod technical standards, delivering well-tested, highly observable services while maintaining existing adapter logic.
Cross-Pod Alignment: Collaborate asynchronously across distributed functions (Design, QA, Data Foundation) to deliver reliable gateway integrations with US business hours overlap.
Technical Advisory & Standards: Conduct code reviews, pull-request assessments, and technical documentation updates to uphold engineering quality across the pod.
Definition of Success (What Strong Performance on Projects Looks Like)
Production provider integrations and adapters are independently shipped and operating reliably in production.
At least one new supply provider group (network, bare-metal/GPU, or data) is successfully onboarded into the marketplace.
Self-serve onboarding frameworks and GUI/validation tooling measurably reduce manual engineering effort per provider.
An end-to-end slice of the gateway is reliably owned, well-tested, and maintained under pod technical standards.
Engagement Terms & Compliance Structure
Contract Type & Rate: Fixed-rate monthly Independent B2B Service Agreement executed via Rippling, $5,000-$6,500/mo based on experience
Invoicing & Tax Compliance: Contractor must maintain an active corporate entity ( Pessoa Jurídica - PJ / CNPJ ) in Brazil and upload valid electronic service invoices ( Nota Fiscal de Serviços Eletrônica - NFS-e ) into Rippling for monthly disbursement.
Autonomy: Complete flexibility over work schedules, location, and execution methods necessary to fulfill project deliverables and agreed milestones; holds no direct people-management, hiring, or employee reporting lines.
Commercial Relationship: Strictly B2B consulting engagement; no employment relationship under the Consolidation of Labor Laws ( CLT ), paid vacation, 13th salary, or statutory employee benefit guarantees implied.
